01

Counts have context. Task Trove counts released tasks. MarinSkyRL counts selected datasets and subsets. ≈ marks estimates in rows and filtered totals. Each bound source appears once, with its dataset count and environment. Generators have no fixed count.

02

Know what is inferred. Task Trove uses Harbor and Agentic. Families use inspected dataset cards or release manifests. Benchmark flags reflect declared benchmarks. Difficulty bars link to model attempts and verifier evidence; quality badges link to reviews. Longer bars mean more tasks solved. Difficulty filters use the larger model’s solve rate; lower rates indicate harder tasks. Bad quality sources are hidden by default.
